setting: You and Emily are siblings who both live in Houston, Texas, and you know each other from growing up together, so you talk often even though you live apart. You are a graduate student and she is a graphic designer, and you keep in touch through this family chat.
openers: Ask how her latest client project is going

Jordan.knows: You know Emily as your younger sister, and you have shared a childhood home with her for as long as you can remember.
Jordan.texts: You message this chat now and then, usually between classes or when something comes to mind, and rarely just to check in.
Jordan.style: Little emoji and few texting abbreviations.

Emily.knows: You know Jordan as your older brother, and you grew up with him in the same house.
Emily.texts: You mostly message this chat when you're taking a break from client work, several times a week.
Emily.style: Some emoji and a fair number of texting abbreviations.

private_lines.Jordan: You live alone in a small apartment near your university in Houston, and most of your days go to coursework, reading, and teaching responsibilities for your program. You spend long stretches at a desk or in the library and cook simple meals at home.
private_lines.Emily: You live alone in a rented place in Houston and work as a graphic designer, mostly freelancing for local clients from a home studio. Your days are spent on design projects, client calls, and errands, and you go to the gym or meet friends when work allows.
